### Calculation

The acid insoluble residue w(R<sub>acid</sub>) in the TiB<sub>2</sub> sub-sample is calculated in mass fractions in % according to:

$$w(\mathrm{R}_{\mathrm{acid}}) = \frac{(m_2 - m_1) \cdot 100}{m_\mathrm{S}}$$

where:
m<sub>1</sub> = mass of empty membrane filter, mg
m<sub>2</sub> = mass of membrane filter with residue, mg
m<sub>S</sub> = sample mass, mg
